description: Edit a module in a collab.demo room; live pages merge it with what people are typing. Give one of: text (replace all), append, find+replace, line (add a list line), key+value (set a canvas/kv entry).

link.description: the room link https://ce-net.com/collab/<code> (a host link carries ?host=<key>)

mod.description: module id from collab_state, e.g. doc, code, canvas

name.description: how you show up in the room, e.g. "Daniel's AI" (40 characters)

name: collab_edit
